title: Enforcement Primitive Interface
description: The shared contract that all enforcement primitives (claims, quarantine zones, evidence gates, etc.) MUST satisfy. Use this schema to validate that a new enforcement primitive type includes all mandatory properties.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this enforcement primitive.

zone.description: Target zone path. All enforcement is zone-scoped.

actor_id.description: Identity of the actor that created this enforcement primitive.

expires_at_unix.description: Expiry timestamp. Remote-origin primitives MUST include this field. Local primitives SHOULD include it but MAY rely on process-shutdown cleanup.

overridable.description: All enforcement primitives MUST be overridable. This field is always true.

override_actor_id.description: Actor who overrode this primitive (populated after override).
